content:
Consider purchasing Reserved Instances (RIs) after you have a good baseline on your performance
and compute consumption. Discounts start at around 30% for no-upfront, 1-year reservations and
can increase up to 50% for all-upfront, 3-year commitments.
After you observe stable operation for at least 14 days, review Accessing reservation
recommendations in the AWS Cost Management User Guide. The Amazon OpenSearch Service
heading displays speciﬁc RI purchase recommendations and projected savings.
